plan: OpenVibe Updated Plan Based On Codebase (T0–T19), T10 step 3 — the forum moved off OpenVibe.Community
deployment: Not deployed yet (T10 step 3 built the service; step 4 is the cutover). The Host inventory entry, the deploy recipe, the Contracts flip (space.json status/exposure live, space.* activated) and the Sites placeholder removal for openvibe.space are the deploy job's. Unit deploy/systemd/openvibe-space.service on 127.0.0.1:4940, vhost deploy/nginx/openvibe.space.conf, database ov_space via OpenVibe.Host roles/data add-service.sh space. Production's forum tables in ov_community are empty except the migration seeds, so the data cutover moves only the schema's rows.
features: spaces: public/members/staff visibility, feed and forum styles, groups, child boards, per-space settings
threads and posts: Markdown (safe renderer), edits with versions, soft deletes, pins and locks
thread votes, Facepunch-style post ratings, categories, statuses, crossposts and quotes
per-space moderators (space_moderators), addable by @username through the Network
image attachments as OpenVibe.Media objects (med_), at most four per post
members-only spaces and threads gated by OpenVibe.VIP (fail closed)
a space's chat room on OpenVibe.Chat, attached with the person's own token
the Discord relay: outbound webhooks, the Events worker, and inbound through the gateway
blocks, token cutoffs, account export/deletion and subject merge from Network events
server-rendered pages with full SEO (robots, llms.txt, sitemap, RSS, IndexNow)
per-actor limits (openvibe-sdk/limits) and per-person write limits
the process boots on a fresh database and stops cleanly (test/boot.test.js)
knownGaps: space.thread.write and space.pulse.read stay 'planned' in openvibe-contracts and Space serves neither; space.post.write carries thread and reply writes and community serves the network Pulse feed
no Search documents (no space.index_document.* contract) and no /search page
the network Pulse feed is Community's: Space publishes no Pulse item and renders no pulse page
paste cards on forum posts were dropped with the move (pastes are Community's)
